summary_md: **Dgorg Iron ([@DgorgIron](https://x.com/DgorgIron/status/2115021949650735429))** introduces **mcp-warden**, which keeps API keys in the OS keychain so agents in Claude Code or Cursor call tools without ever seeing credentials; local, scoped, with approvals and an audit trail.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - ermoluk/mcp-warden: Local-first credential broker for MCP. AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…) call APIs, SSH and databases through scoped presets; secrets stay in your OS keychain and never enter the agent's context.

relevance: Credential isolation for MCP tools — a practical harness security pattern.
